_comment: The few words of an ad in the paper's classifieds, written once when the ad is placed and kept with it. Which pool
an ad draws from is the game's to decide (Services/Market/AdBlurbs.cs): a part worth naming first, then the engine,
all original, the condition, low miles, or a line of character; now and then a car's ad adds its condition after.
Each pool gives one line at random. A car's ad: {part} the part's name (ads.car.blower, turbo, nitrous, carbs (a
carburettor or injection: the game cannot tell them apart), heads, cam, intake, headers), {engine} what the seller says about the engine ("GM 327, 275 hp";
ads.car.engine and ads.car.built only), {km} the mileage (ads.car.low_miles, as {km:distance}). A part's ad: {part}
the part's name, {kind} its kind as a shop's shelf says it ("Camshafts"). ads.car.mint and ads.car.rough take
nothing, nor do the character lines, nor what the car shows (ads.car.rust, ads.car.paint, ads.car.cracked_screen):
a car that shows rust, worn paint, a cracked windshield or its dirt is never called mint.

ads.car.blower: Blown with a {part}. Not for the timid.
Wears a {part}. You'll hear it coming.
ads.car.nitrous: Has the bottle: {part}. Push the button, hang on.
ads.car.carbs: Fed by a {part}. Ready to run.
ads.car.cam: {part} in it. Idles rough, runs hard.
ads.car.built: Worked-over {engine}. Too much car for me.
{engine}, lots of speed parts. Must sell.
ads.car.original: Bone stock, as it left the factory.
Original paint and interior. Kept up.
ads.car.rough: Rough but solid. Priced to go.
ads.car.rust: Some rust. Nothing a welder can't fix.
Rust in the usual places. Solid underneath.
ads.car.character: Grandma's car. Church on Sundays only.
Moving out of state. Best offer.
Bought a boat. Car has to go.
Baby on the way. Trading for a wagon.
Won it in a card game. Make me an offer.
Hate to let it go. Call evenings.
First $ takes it. No tire kickers.
ads.part.engine: Whole {part}. Drop it in and go.
ads.part.speed: Hot setup. Too much for my street car.
Speed shop quality, half the price.
ads.part.fresh: Hardly used. Still has the shine.
ads.part.worn: Needs a rebuild. Priced to go.
ads.part.racer: Swapped for more power. Yours now.
ads.part.character: No room for it. Cash only.
